start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:trillion-x-mode. Request: let customers cancel a subscription from the order page. Scope: the bakery site's order page only. Constraints: no change to prices, no emails to customers. Authorized actions: edit the order page and read the payment dashboard."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: each step's answer carries its own evidence and requirement records, and any nested run is a recipe run of the workflow it names.
instructions: 1. Write the request (up to 30000 characters), its scope (a clear boundary, up to 5000 characters), the constraints (each a plain sentence, up to 100) and the authorized actions (each a plain sentence, up to 100); source_id is optional.

2. Say "Run workflow:trillion-x-mode" with request, scope, constraints and authorized_actions. The mode grants no extra access, spending, publication, deployment or authority over another person: only what you list is authorized.

3. Step scope answers with a summary, the evidence it read (id, source, observed) and seven requirements: outcome, raw-material, authority, reality, possibility-space, what-is-optimized and untainted, each completed with what happened and the evidence ids it rests on.

4. Steps reuse, design, action-lifecycle-inventory, build, proof and action-lifecycle-proof reuse existing work, choose the generic shape, account for create, read, edit and delete and the other actions, build the change and prove each required action through its real entry point (success, refusal and recovery).
5. Steps release and learn verify the authorized delivery and keep the lesson; a required step that is blocked stays open with its exact gap and is never submitted as completed.

worked_examples.title: Scope turns a cancel request into a named outcome with authority and limits
worked_examples.ask: Let customers cancel a subscription from the order page, order page only, no price or email changes.

input.request: Let customers cancel a subscription from the order page.
input.scope: The bakery site's order page only.

Excluded: price changes and emails to customers.","evidence_refs":["e2"]},"reality":{"state":"completed","what_happened":"Observed: the order page has a receipt link per order and no cancel action; the payment dashboard shows which orders renew.","evidence_refs":["e3"]},"possibility-space":{"state":"completed","what_happened":"Inherited belief that cancelling needs an email to the shop: marked inherited, shown false by a button that calls the same cancel the shop uses.","evidence_refs":["e1"]},"what-is-optimized":{"state":"completed","what_happened":"Optimized for the customer finishing a cancellation without asking anyone, not for fewer cancellations.","evidence_refs":["e1"]},"untainted":{"state":"completed","what_happened":"The customer-facing words stay the person's own; the AI's reading of the request is marked as its own.","evidence_refs":["e1","e2"]}}}
